One content-block image for /pages/firming-skin-density — templates/page.firming-skin-density.json, section `content`, block `causes`, 'What Causes Loss of Firmness?'. Malcolm, 2026-08-25: a professional medical-beauty explainer diagram in the style of the ones already chosen on the research pages. It currently wears a borrowed product texture shot, skingenetix-copper-peptide-night-cream-texture.jpg.

STYLE INHERITED, WHOLESALE, from the copper-peptide r3 / matrixyl medical set: soft glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient ground; a layered cross-section with legible strata, or a macro of the fibre network itself; teal fibre, desaturated peach-cream tissue; no lettering of any kind, no arrows, no callouts, no infographic furniture. Square 2048x2048 to match the sibling blocks — the row height in `media-with-text` is set by the master's own aspect, so anything other than 1:1 makes this block taller than the other five (see the key-findings-box memory; it has now been learned twice on this store).

COLOUR IS TEAL 016569. Per the concern-to-colour map in 03-art-direction-and-briefs.md §1.2, Firming & Skin Density is bound to Matrixyl 3000's Teal 016569 — the same scene colour as /pages/matrixyl-3000-research. Copper, gold, royal blue and cobalt are negated so this never drifts into the copper-peptide page's Clinical blue.

THE ONE THING THAT MAKES THIS SET DIFFERENT: IT IS A PICTURE OF LOSS. Every explainer chosen on this store so far shows an active arriving and a structure being built — delivery spheres above the surface, shafts of light descending, starburst glints at the point of arrival, new fibre streaming from a cell. This block is the opposite claim. It is the damage, before any product is mentioned; the very next block on the page ('The Collagen-Peptide Approach to Firming') is where the repair belongs. If this frame carries spheres, light shafts, peptide chains or glints it will read as the treatment working, and the page will make its argument backwards.

So the family's own signature devices are NEGATED HERE, deliberately and by name, which no previous brief in this family has had to do. The engines have been shown this house style repeatedly and will reach for it. Everything is negated except the ground, the palette, the gloss and the cross-section grammar.

WHAT THE COPY ACTUALLY CLAIMS, and which concept carries which:
  1. Collagen degradation — MMPs break collagen down faster than it is replaced; UV, inflammation and pollution accelerate it. Carried by A as bundles that are notched, eroded and fraying, and by C as a density falloff.
  2. Elastin fragmentation — elastin is barely replaced after adolescence, and once damaged the fibres fragment and cannot reassemble, so the loss of bounce is permanent. Carried by B, which is the only concept that shows the SNAPPED, RECOILED ends that make the loss permanent, and echoed in A.
  3. Fat pad redistribution — the deep facial fat pads shrink and slide downward. Carried by C, the only concept that goes deep enough to include that stratum. It is a real anatomical layer, so it can be shown as one, without a face.
  4. Hormonal change — a driver, not a visible structure. Not depicted. Nothing in these frames should try to.

NO MMP IS DRAWN AS A CHARACTER. An enzyme rendered as a little agent chewing a fibre reads as bacteria or an insect in every engine, and it is also the kind of assertion the copy does not make. Degradation is shown as its EVIDENCE — notched, thinned, fraying, parted fibre with fine drifting debris — never as an actor. Bacteria, viruses, insects, mites and worms are all negated.

NO BEFORE-AND-AFTER SPLIT, on the r3 rule: a split frame asserts by juxtaposition and these engines render it as a hard seam down the middle. Where a contrast is needed (B's taut corner, C's falloff) it is a SMOOTH GRADIENT ACROSS ONE CONTINUOUS SCENE, which carries the same information and stays a photograph of one thing.

CLASS B THROUGHOUT — no product in frame, no references attached, therefore no product description and no brand identity given to any engine ('reference-free shots must not get product desc'). FLUX.2 is in the run: there is no branding for it to invent and it is strong on abstract structural CGI. Watch it for printed numbers all the same — that is a fixed trait, and this brief has no numbers in it.

JUDGE AT 100% AND AGAIN AT RENDER SIZE. The failure mode here is not lettering, it is TEXTURE COHERENCE: fibre bundles that resolve into a woven textile, a rope, a spider web or a knitted mesh instead of collagen. That is invisible on a contact sheet and obvious at native pixels. Textile, rope, web, knit, wicker and basketry are negated.

slots.title: A · cross-section, the dermal scaffold thinned and parted, the surface sinking into it
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A small block of skin is shown in cross-section from a low three-quarter angle, isolated in clean empty space with nothing around it, floating on a smooth translucent base. Three strata are legible. Across the top, a thin smooth surface layer in soft desaturated peach-cream, its outer face finely tiled like fine skin. Beneath it, filling most of the block, an open matrix of long wavy glossy fibre bundles in a deep blue-green teal, colour hex 016569, running horizontally through a soft peach-cream ground. Along the base, a plain pale cream floor.

THE MATRIX HAS BEEN LOST, AND THE SURFACE IS FOLLOWING IT DOWN. The fibre bundles are thin, slack and unevenly spaced, with wide empty gaps opened between them where a dense weave used to be. Many bundles are notched and eroded along their length, worn narrow in the middle like a frayed cord, their glossy skin dulled to a greyed teal where they have thinned. Several have parted entirely, and the two ends have drawn back from each other and curled, leaving a clear gap of empty space between them; the broken ends are blunt and slightly swollen and do not meet. A fine drift of tiny pale fragments hangs in the open space around the worst-damaged bundles, the debris of fibre that has come apart.

Because the scaffold beneath it has thinned, the surface layer sags: it is drawn down into one long soft valley across the middle of the block, thinner and stretched where it dips, and the layer below it is compressed under the dip. Toward one end of the block the fibres are a little denser and the surface there is still level, and the change between the two is a slow smooth gradient across one continuous surface, never a line or an edge.

Nothing is arriving, nothing is being rebuilt, and the block is empty of anything but tissue. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: B · macro of the elastic network, coiled fibres snapped mid-span with the ends recoiled
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

An extreme macro view deep inside a mesh of long elastic fibres, filling the frame edge to edge with no container and no surrounding scene, as though the camera is inside the material itself. The fibres are smooth glossy translucent strands in a deep blue-green teal, colour hex 016569, each with a fine natural spring to it, crossing and interlacing at shallow angles and running away into a soft out-of-focus haze at the back of the frame. The ground behind them is pale, warm and hazy.

THE MESH HAS BROKEN AND IT CANNOT COME BACK TOGETHER. Through the middle of the frame many of the strands have snapped part way along their span. At every break the two ends have sprung apart and recoiled into loose spirals, springs released and left slack, and the parted ends now hang a clear distance from one another with soft empty space between. The ends themselves are blunt and slightly bulbous, torn rather than cut, and the teal in them has faded toward a dull grey-green. Short orphaned pieces of fibre drift free in the gaps, curled and going nowhere, and a fine dust of pale fragments hangs in the light.

Where the strands are still whole they are taut, springy, richly coloured and evenly spaced, and they carry a clean highlight along their length. This intact region sits toward one corner of the frame and gives way to the broken region through a slow smooth gradient — density and colour falling away gradually across one continuous mesh, with no line, no edge and no seam anywhere in the picture.

The whole mesh sags in the broken region, hanging heavier and lower than the taut corner, so the material visibly loses its spring across the frame. Nothing is arriving, nothing is being rebuilt. Shallow depth of field, soft diffuse light, no hard shadow. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: C · full-depth block, dense matrix falling away to sparse with the fat layer thinned and slipped
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A long low block of skin is shown in cross-section from a low three-quarter angle, isolated in clean empty space with nothing around it and floating on a smooth translucent base, so it reads as a specimen rather than part of a body. It is seen from the side so that its full depth is legible, four strata stacked from top to bottom.

At the top, a thin smooth outer layer in soft desaturated peach-cream, its face finely tiled like fine skin. Below it, a band of small pale rounded cells packed in neat rows. Below that, the thickest layer: an open matrix of long wavy glossy fibre bundles in a deep blue-green teal, colour hex 016569, lying in horizontal courses through a soft peach-cream ground. At the very bottom, a deep cushion of large soft rounded translucent lobules in a pale warm cream, clustered together like a bed of smooth pebbles.

EVERYTHING THINS FROM ONE END OF THE BLOCK TO THE OTHER, SMOOTHLY AND CONTINUOUSLY. At the left end the teal matrix is dense, thick, evenly woven and richly coloured, the cushion of lobules beneath it is deep and full and round, and the outer surface above is level and taut. Travelling toward the right end, the fibre bundles gradually become fewer, thinner and paler, worn narrow and frayed in places and parted in others with the ends drawn back and curled; the gaps between them widen until they are mostly empty space; the cushion of lobules loses depth, its lobules shrinking and flattening and sliding downward and to the right so the bed of them slumps away from the layers above and leaves a soft hollow beneath them; and the outer surface, unsupported, sinks into a long slack downward curve and gathers into a soft fold near the right end where it has more area than it has structure to hold.

The change from one end to the other is a slow even gradient across one continuous block — no line, no seam, no join, no division, nothing repeated and nothing mirrored. A fine drift of tiny pale fragments hangs in the open gaps at the sparse end.

Nothing is arriving and nothing is being rebuilt. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
